$comment: Draft from docs/portfolio.md, 'Contracts'. Product data has one owner per field (ownership rule 3): this document carries the fields product-feed owns; website content fields stay with seo.
title: catalog/1
description: What is for sale: SKU, price, availability and promotion windows, per market. product-feed writes it; operators read prices and promotion windows, makers read what a creative may show, seo reads what a page may say.
x-rules: A sku appears once per market.
A price is in the market's currency and is what the shopper pays before any promotion; a promotion's sale_price is what they pay inside its window.
A promotion window is from starts_on to ends_on, both included.
An absent optional key means unknown, never null and never an empty string.

producer.description: The pack that wrote the document (its CLI word).

produced_at.description: When the document was written: ISO 8601 with its zone.

products.description: The products; empty when there are none.

sku.description: The product's SKU, the key every other pack uses for it.

market.description: The market the row is for (the hub's market word).

title.description: The product's name as the shopper sees it.

url.description: The product's page, when it has one.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code of price and sale_price.

availability.description: Whether it can be bought now.

stock.description: Units on hand, when the feed knows.

promotions.description: The promotion windows, past, current and announced; empty when none.

promotion_id.description: Unique for the sku and stable across documents.

starts_on.description: First day of the window, YYYY-MM-DD.

ends_on.description: Last day of the window, YYYY-MM-DD.

sale_price.description: The price inside the window, when the promotion sets one.

label.description: The promotion's name as the shopper sees it.
